title: Why Lamborghini Bet Everything on an SUV
description:
In twenty seventeen, Lamborghini sold three thousand, eight hundred fifteen cars. Two years later, it sold eight thousand, two hundred five. More than half of them were one single model, and it was an SUV. The company that built the Miura and the Countach had bet its future on a family car with five seats. This is why Lamborghini bet everything on the Urus, and whether the bet paid off. Here is the twist. This was not the first time. Lamborghini had built an SUV in nineteen eighty-six, a military-style truck with a Countach engine, and it was cancelled after only three hundred one were built. The Urus is the second attempt. And the second attempt changed the company completely.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
